primary_endpoint: Number of patients with improvement in liver histology between baseline and 24–28 weeks; change in NAS from baseline to 28 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Eight participants had improvement in liver histology; mean change in NAS was −1.5. No comparator or statistical significance was reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 0/8 participants in the exenatide group; deaths not reported.
